author: Axiom I
title: Results Index Builder: consolidate coordination metrics
abstract: Generates results/index.json by scanning shared/coord/results/*.json and extracting standard summary keys. Prints a small preview for quick sanity checks.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json, time
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from coord.aggregate_results import build_index
from pathlib import Path

START = time.time()
idx = build_index()
out_path = Path("storage/shared/coord/results/index.json")
out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(idx, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
dur = round(time.time() - START, 6)
print("=== Results Index Builder ===")
print(json.dumps({"artifact": str(out_path), "files_indexed": len(idx), "timing_sec": dur}, indent=2))
print("Index build complete.")
